items.description: A stock record filed for a uuid-suffixed SKU via POST to the stock API is subsequently retrievable via GET for that SKU and location
The stock_records Alembic migration downgrades one step and re-upgrades to the same schema without error
The boundary module (app/routes/) does not import the database session object
The service module (app/services/) contains no ORM or session import
The boundary module (app/routes/) contains no ORM import
No hardcoded database connection string exists in any module under app/
The application sources its database connection exclusively from the DATABASE_URL environment variable
The service layer raises a rejection error for a write that would result in a negative quantity before the DB CHECK constraint is reached
No server-side template rendering call exists in app/routes/
A validation error response from the boundary layer identifies the specific offending field by name
The pytest integration suite connects exclusively to the database specified by DATABASE_URL from the environment
An insert into stock_records with a NULL quantity value is rejected by the database
An insert into stock_records with a NULL sku value is rejected by the database
An insert into stock_records with a NULL location value is rejected by the database
An insert into stock_records with a NULL inventory_code value is rejected by the database
An insert into stock_records with quantity = -1 is rejected by the database CHECK constraint ck_stock_records_quantity_non_negative
Rows seeded in stock_records before a subsequent additive migration is applied are present with their original field values after that migration runs
Retrieving a previously filed stock record for a uuid-suffixed SKU via the API returns the exact quantity that was originally filed
Retrieving a previously filed stock record for a uuid-suffixed SKU via the API returns the exact combined inventory_code that was originally filed
Filing stock a second time for the same uuid-suffixed SKU and location pair via the API does not return an error response
After filing stock twice for the same uuid-suffixed SKU and location pair via the API, a GET for that pair returns only one record bearing the second filing's quantity
Filing a stock record twice for the same (sku, location) pair stores exactly one row in stock_records
A concurrent second write for the same (sku, location) pair within the upsert transaction does not produce a second row in stock_records
The created_at timestamp on a stock_records row is unchanged after an in-place upsert resolves a (sku, location) collision
